candidate.name: react-bio-viz
candidate.notes: PhyloTree/SimplePhyloTree (SVG, one element set per node, no culling). Adapter workarounds: DOM hover, own column canvas, leafSpacing+viewport focus, synthetic lengths for radial cladogram.

tipClick.how: onNodeClick fires for leaf markers (TreeNodeInfo.isLeaf); markers are drawn for every leaf and receive clicks as soon as onNodeClick is set

internalNodeClick.how: onNodeClick on the internal-node marker (drawn when onNodeClick or interactive is set); payload carries leafNames and descendantIds

branchClick.how: onBranchClick adds a wide transparent hit path per branch; reports the node below the branch with its leafNames

hover.how: the library has no hover callback. Workaround: delegated DOM mouseover on the wrapper (circle[data-node-id], path[data-branch-id], label group); tip sets are derived from the shared TreeModel (source adapter-derived)

descendantTipsInPayload.how: TreeNodeInfo.leafNames (all leaves below the node) in the library payload on click; not on hover (adapter-derived there)

cladeColouring.how: nodeStyles/branchStyles (colour per node id) for every descendant id, built in React state. Works, but each change re-renders the whole tree body (all nodes), so it is not an incremental update and cost grows with tree size; branch width cannot change per clade

highlightTip.how: nodeStyles colour+bold on the tip marker and a halo/bold in the leafTextComponent slot; optional library search (searchQuery regex) dims all other tips

focusTip.how: no focus API. Workaround: leafSpacing (px per row, library prop) when rows are thinner than 14 px, then a computed controlled viewport read back from the rendered marker position; relayouts the whole tree; radial zooms 8x around the marker

tipAsLink.how: leafTextComponent renders an SVG <a href target=_blank data-tip-id tabindex=0> around the label text for every tip (all tips are in the DOM, there is no culling)

customColumns.how: the library has no per-tip columns. Workaround: own canvas right of the tree, rows read back from the rendered markers and aligned through svg.getScreenCTM() on every viewport change; rectangular layouts only

alignmentColumn.how: same own canvas as customColumns (residue runs coloured per amino acid); not a library feature (react-bio-viz has a separate MultipleSequenceAlignment component whose row order can be linked, not used here)

radialLayout.how: layout="radial": circular phylogram with labels on spokes (names truncated to 24 chars); columns are not drawn in radial

branchLengthToggle.how: rectangular: layout rectangular (phylogram) versus cladogram (library). Radial is always a phylogram: the cladogram variant feeds synthetic lengths (clade height differences, adapter-derived) so tips align; negative lengths are clamped to 0 in a copy

scaleBar.how: showScaleBar (default on) draws an I-beam of a round length at the bottom of the tree; no time axis for dated trees; hidden in cladogram layout

darkTheme.how: no theme prop: the stylesheet reads a .dark class and shadcn CSS variables (--background, --foreground, --primary, ...); the adapter sets them on its wrapper from gbifDarkTheme(). Branches/markers are currentColor so they follow; support/scale text keep sans-serif unless overridden with !important CSS

cssTokens.how: CSS custom properties (--background, --foreground, --rbv-accent, shadcn tokens) are honoured; label font only via the leafTextComponent slot; support-value, scale-bar and collapsed-clade fonts are inline sans-serif and need !important CSS to change; branch opacity is a presentation attribute (CSS opacity:1 overrides)

multipleInstances.how: no module-level state seen; per-instance Zustand store, two instances tested through window.__spike2

cleanUnmount.how: React unmount; window pointer listeners are removed by the library effect cleanup; injected <style id> stays in document.head by design

controlledState.how: viewport/onViewportChange and selection/onSelectionChange are controlled props (also *Store variants); colours, layout and all other inputs are plain props

zoomToFit.how: the viewport is clamped to the extent, so zooming out stops at the fit view; PhyloTree toolbar has a reset button; fit on mount and layout change by the adapter (viewport state reset)

overviewOrMinimap.how: no minimap; no level of detail or culling: every node and label stays in the SVG at every zoom (collapse is manual or collapseBySupport)

caveat: Headless Chromium without a GPU (SwiftShader software rendering): absolute FPS for canvas and WebGL candidates is pessimistic; use for functional tests and relative comparison. Final scale numbers need a real browser on a normal laptop.

thresholds.note: unusable = load > 10 s, or > 50% of the time in frames > 50 ms (best of 3 rounds), or > 100 ms main-thread CPU per interaction step, or click latency > 300 ms; p5 FPS is reported (best of 3) but not judged

load.note: os.loadavg()[0] (1-minute); runs with start or end load above 4 are marked noisy
